settings.heading:
What [price]
actually buys.
settings.lede: Not a comparison. A breakdown. What goes into the mattress, what we spend it on, and why the number is what it is.

settings.label: The core
settings.text: Hand-assembled pocket springs, individually pocketed. Assembly is done by hand because a machine cannot pull tension through the fillings. It is the slowest part of the build and the reason it lasts.

settings.label: The comfort layer
settings.text: Separately constructed, zipped in. Medium on one face, medium firm on the other. Built as its own product because it has to be replaceable.

settings.label: The cover
settings.text: Finished by hand at the tape edge.

settings.label: Made to order
settings.text: Nothing is built before you buy it. No warehouse, no stock write-off, no clearance sale of last season's tension.

settings.label: No showroom
settings.text: The saving is roughly a third of the retail price of a comparable mattress, and it is the reason a handmade bed is [price] rather than twice that.

settings.heading: Where the money goes
settings.lede: Most mattresses at this price carry a retailer margin and a showroom. Ours carries neither.

settings.heading: Built to be kept
settings.body:
A pocket sprung core lasts toward [X] years. The top lasts seven or eight. Every mattress you have ever replaced was replaced because of the part that wears fastest.

Ours comes apart. When the comfort layer softens it unzips, a new one goes on, and the core stays exactly where it is.

You are not buying a mattress that lasts longer than the alternatives. You are buying one you do not have to replace.

settings.heading: A showroom
settings.text: You cannot lie on it before buying. That is why every mattress arrives with two feels in one layer, and why a different tension, worth [layer], is complimentary if neither suits.

settings.heading: Next day delivery
settings.text: It is made after you order it. That takes weeks, not days.

settings.heading: A hundred year history
settings.text: We are new. The specification is the argument, not the heritage.

settings.heading: What we do not offer
settings.lede: Worth saying plainly, because you will find out anyway.
settings.promise_body: If the feel is not right, we send a replacement comfort layer free of charge. If that does not fix it, we collect the mattress and refund you in full.

settings.heading: Choose your size
settings.lede: Every size is handmade to order with the same 37cm construction and the same removable comfort layer.
